text: If every step you take is seventy-five centimeters long <break time="0.4s" /> how many steps would it take to walk around the entire world?
The Earth is about forty thousand kilometers around. <break time="0.3s" /> That is over forty million meters.
Divide that by seventy-five centimeters <break time="0.3s" /> and the math gets wild.
That is fifty-three million steps. <break time="0.4s" /> Just to get back where you started.
Walk ten thousand steps every single day <break time="0.3s" /> and you will need over five thousand days.
That is more than fourteen years of nonstop walking. <break time="0.3s" /> No days off.
Still want to try? <break time="0.3s" /> Follow for more mind-blowing math.
